aspirin|ibuprofen.mechanism: Concurrent use may reduce aspirin's antiplatelet effect and can increase gastrointestinal adverse-effect risk.
aspirin|ibuprofen.management: Discuss regular combined use with a clinician or pharmacist; do not change prescribed treatment based on this tool.

evidence.title: Aspirin drug label interaction information
evidence.excerpt: Official labeling should be checked for the exact product and patient context.

aspirin|warfarin.mechanism: Both medicines can increase bleeding risk through different antithrombotic effects.
aspirin|warfarin.management: High-risk educational alert: seek prompt advice from the prescribing clinician or pharmacist before any medication change.

evidence.title: Warfarin label
evidence.excerpt: Anticoagulant labeling contains clinically important interaction and bleeding warnings.

clopidogrel|warfarin.mechanism: Combining antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects can increase bleeding risk.
clopidogrel|warfarin.management: High-risk educational alert: contact the care team or pharmacist for patient-specific review.

evidence.title: Clopidogrel prescribing information
evidence.excerpt: Use current product labeling and clinician assessment for bleeding-risk decisions.

fluoxetine|tramadol.mechanism: The combination can increase serotonergic adverse-effect risk and may affect seizure risk in susceptible patients.
fluoxetine|tramadol.management: High-risk educational alert: ask a qualified clinician or pharmacist to review this combination.

evidence.title: Tramadol drug-label information
evidence.excerpt: Check current labeling for interaction warnings and patient-specific contraindications.

linezolid|sertraline.mechanism: Linezolid has monoamine oxidase inhibitory activity and can interact with serotonergic medicines.
linezolid|sertraline.management: High-risk educational alert: a prescriber must assess this combination; do not self-manage treatment.

evidence.title: Linezolid prescribing information
evidence.excerpt: Consult the current product label and a clinician for serotonin syndrome precautions.
